claim: Raft's practical unit is a deterministic replicated log committed by a quorum.
jet_evidence: No replicated-log implementation; docs/plans/epoch-3/universal-language-core.md:199 names #444.
action: Add a production consensus substrate and record its durable recovery contract.

claim: Raft elects one strong leader with randomized timeouts and heartbeat authority.
jet_evidence: No leader-election runtime or consensus command in probes/help.out.
action: Add observable election, heartbeat, quorum-loss, and transfer behavior.

claim: Raft joint consensus overlaps old and new majorities during membership change.
jet_evidence: No joint-membership implementation in Source/crates/examples.
action: Support safe membership transitions with quorum evidence.

claim: Raft snapshots compact committed prefixes and repair lagging followers.
jet_evidence: No consensus snapshot or compaction implementation found.
action: Add bounded snapshot, install, compaction, and recovery paths.

claim: etcd/raft separates deterministic Message stepping from I/O.
jet_evidence: Jet has generic proof/replay law but no consensus Message state machine.
action: Expose a deterministic consensus transition core before binding transports.

claim: etcd/raft's Ready/Advance seam lets the host own persistence, transport, apply, and backpressure.
jet_evidence: No equivalent consensus storage/network seam in current Jet code.
action: Define explicit durable and outbound boundaries around the core.

claim: etcd offers quorum linearizable reads and a separately documented lease-read tradeoff.
jet_evidence: No distributed read consistency mode in current Jet surfaces.
action: Expose read consistency and clock assumptions explicitly.

claim: FoundationDB provides ACID transactions over a distributed ordered key-value store.
jet_evidence: Jet #Transact is local Shared rollback, not a distributed database transaction.
action: Add a distributed transactional storage contract with recovery evidence.

claim: FoundationDB's lexicographically ordered byte keys support selectors, ranges, and range clears.
jet_evidence: No ordered distributed KV or range selector API found.
action: Provide ordered durable key/range primitives.

claim: FoundationDB uses subspaces, tuples, directories, and tenants to structure one keyspace.
jet_evidence: No corresponding namespace/tenant layer found.
action: Add typed namespacing and tenant isolation over storage.

claim: FoundationDB layers remain stateless over the transactional core.
jet_evidence: No composable distributed storage layer seam exists.
action: Keep storage extensions stateless and composable.

claim: FoundationDB Simulation runs real cluster code under deterministic simulated time and machine/network/storage faults.
jet_evidence: Jet proof/replay is generic and no cluster simulator exists.
action: Build deterministic cluster simulation with fault and schedule records.

claim: FoundationDB uses separate simulation, hardware-failure, and Circus performance campaigns over realistic large workloads.
jet_evidence: gauntlet has no FoundationDB/distributed cell.
action: Add a distributed correctness/performance matrix before making a speed claim.

claim: Automerge makes local offline edits converge without coordination or lost work.
jet_evidence: D-SYNC1 and probes/sync_min.out show three merge orders converge.
action: Preserve the contract and add cross-tier interoperability evidence.

claim: Automerge exposes history, old versions, diffs, branches, and merges.
jet_evidence: Jet exposes Lamport metadata but no document history/version/branch API.
action: Add inspectable document history and recovery operations.

claim: Automerge combines map/list/text/counter/scalar values under a change API.
jet_evidence: Jet SyncMap/SyncList/SyncText/SyncCounter and generic carriers are implemented.
action: Keep the shipped core shapes and test Codable boundaries.

claim: Automerge Repo isolates durable storage behind StorageAdapter and ships IndexedDB/NodeFS adapters.
jet_evidence: Jet sync session registry is process-memory only.
action: Add durable restart-safe sync storage.

claim: Automerge Repo composes multiple network adapters including WebSocket and browser message channels.
jet_evidence: Jet app.sync publishes a fixed live transport topic and has no adapter interface.
action: Separate document semantics from selectable peer transports.

claim: Y.Doc batches changes in transact and emits observer/update events once per transaction.
jet_evidence: Jet CRDT values have no transaction event/observer API.
action: Add bounded change batching and event delivery.

claim: Yjs propagates binary state updates through encodeStateAsUpdate/applyUpdate with order-independent convergence.
jet_evidence: Jet app.sync accepts canonical String at the fixed Core boundary; no binary update API.
action: Add bounded versioned update bytes and authenticated application.

claim: Yjs keeps ephemeral user/cursor presence in a separate Awareness CRDT that disappears offline.
jet_evidence: No presence/awareness surface exists in Jet sync code.
action: Add optional non-persistent presence with explicit lifecycle.

claim: Yjs providers cover IndexedDB, LevelDB, and Redis persistence for one update model.
jet_evidence: No persistence provider registry or compatible update format exists.
action: Cover browser, local, and service-side persistence classes.

claim: Jet SyncText uses atom identity and deterministic RGA ordering with deletion-wins merge and malformed-state refusal.
jet_evidence: probes/sync_min.out converges; probes/sync_invalid.out returns SyncError.
action: Preserve bounded refusal and test adversarial identities.

claim: Jet SyncMap/SyncList/SyncCounter and generic Codable carriers cover common collaborative values.
jet_evidence: probes/sync_min.out prints counter:6, SyncMap(k=v2), SyncList(r1:a|r2:b).
action: Retain deterministic tie-breaks and overflow bounds.

claim: A Lamport order is not a causal vector; Automerge/Yjs expose causal knowledge needed for safe compaction.
jet_evidence: Jet explicitly emits LamportClock and says it is not a vector clock.
action: Separate causal acknowledgements from display ordering.

claim: Jet app.sync keeps named session generations idempotent and publishes changed receipts through live transport.
jet_evidence: D-SYNC1; source enforces duplicate delivery idempotence and probe covers core merge path.
action: Keep idempotence while adding durable/multi-process state later.

claim: Jepsen evaluates declared consistency safety properties against observed histories and dependency graphs.
jet_evidence: No model-driven distributed history checker in Jet proof/replay or CLI.
action: Add history capture, model selection, and counterexample output.

claim: Maelstrom lets any language join a distributed workload using JSON stdin/stdout and stderr diagnostics.
jet_evidence: No Maelstrom-compatible node harness or command in Jet.
action: Add a bounded machine-readable node protocol and runner.

claim: Maelstrom exposes topology, latency, rate, concurrency, partition, kill, and pause controls as test inputs.
jet_evidence: No deterministic partition/kill/pause fault campaign exists.

claim: Maelstrom renders timelines, message statistics, time series, and Lamport diagrams from histories.
jet_evidence: Jet has bounded task diagnostics but no distributed causal visualization.

claim: TigerBeetle combines strict serializability with unique u128 request IDs and at-most-once processing.
jet_evidence: Jet #Transact covers local atomic Shared writes only.

claim: TigerBeetle VOPR runs real cluster code under deterministic faults and replays failures.
jet_evidence: No distributed VOPR-like simulator; current generic prove probe fails E2105.

claim: TigerBeetle minimizes normal replication cost with batching, pipelining, static allocation, and one leader core.
jet_evidence: Jet scheduler is general M:N work stealing, not a replicated-storage hot path.

claim: gRPC uses proto3 service/message schemas plus protoc plugins to generate cross-language stubs/codecs.

claim: Cap'n Proto promise pipelining collapses dependent remote calls into one round trip.
jet_evidence: Jet has no remote promise pipeline surface.

claim: Cap'n Proto treats capability references as authority-bearing values with explicit disconnect behavior.
jet_evidence: Jet authority/effects are local; no remote capability references.

claim: Paxos safety relies on majority acceptors and stable promise/accepted-value storage across restart.
jet_evidence: No Paxos or equivalent durable consensus implementation exists.

claim: TLA+ models concurrent/distributed systems mathematically and supplies TLC/TLAPS tools.
jet_evidence: No TLA+/TLC/TLAPS command or import surface appears in Jet help.

claim: Jet's crossing fact plane rejects mutable captures, views, and Cells while channels move owned sendable values.

claim: TigerBeetle uses immutable checksummed/hash-chained data and Protocol Aware Recovery for corruption and upgrade safety.
